25966-camp-fire-and-wigwam.title: Camp Fire And Wigwam
25966-camp-fire-and-wigwam.creator: Unknown
25966-camp-fire-and-wigwam.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. On the evening of a dismal, rainy day in spring, a mother and her son were sitting in their log-cabin home in the southern portion of the present State of Missouri. The settlement bore the name of Martinsville, in honor of the leader of the little party of pioneers who had left Kentucky some months before, and, crossing the Mississippi, located in that portion of the vast territory known at that time as Louisiana.

arxiv-2103-14395.title: Dynamical elastic contact of a rope with the ground
arxiv-2103-14395.creator: Gregory Kozyreff, Benoît Seron
arxiv-2103-14395.description: Abstract A rope laid on the ground with one end subjected to time-dependent forcing is proposed as a prototypical elastic dynamical contact problem, which we study analytically, numerically, and experimentally. The dynamics is governed by an infinite set of linear and nonlinear resonances.

arxiv-2107-13589.title: Improved quantum error correction using soft information
arxiv-2107-13589.creator: Christopher A. Pattison, Michael E. Beverland, Marcus P. da Silva, Nicolas Delfosse
arxiv-2107-13589.description: Abstract The typical model for measurement noise in quantum error correction is to randomly flip the binary measurement outcome. In experiments, measurements yield much richer information—e.g., continuous current values, discrete photon counts—which is then mapped into binary outcomes by discarding some of this information.

arxiv-2403-06829.title: Constructing Variables Using Classifiers as an Aid to Regression: An Empirical Assessment
arxiv-2403-06829.creator: Colin Troisemaine, Vincent Lemaire
arxiv-2403-06829.description: Abstract This paper proposes a method for the automatic creation of variables (in the case of regression) that complement the information contained in the initial input vector. The method works as a pre-processing step in which the continuous values of the variable to be regressed are discretized into a set of intervals which are then used to define value thresholds.

arxiv-2411-08435.title: Dynamic Programming–Compatible Uncertainty Sets in Robust Markov Decision Processes
arxiv-2411-08435.creator: Julien Grand-Clément, Nian Si, Shengbo Wang
arxiv-2411-08435.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Julien Grand-Clément, Nian Si, Shengbo Wang. In this paper, we investigate the compatibility of robust Markov Decision Processes (RMDPs) with dynamic programming under various assumptions on the uncertainty set, i.e., we investigate when one can solve an RMDP by solving a fixed point equation. We show that in all generality, s-rectangular and sa-rectangular uncertainty sets are the only models of uncertainty that are compatible with dynamic programming.

pmc-10535489.title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations of Drug-Conjugated Cell-Penetrating Peptides
pmc-10535489.creator: Márton Ivánczi, Balázs Balogh, Loretta Kis, István Mándity
pmc-10535489.description: Cell-penetrating peptides (CPPs) are small peptides capable of translocating through biological membranes carrying various attached cargo into cells and even into the nucleus. They may also participate in transcellular transport. Our in silico study intends to model several peptides and their conjugates.

pmc-11605099.title: Abnormal topological structure of structural covariance networks based on fractal dimension in noise induced hearing loss
pmc-11605099.creator: Wang Liping, Lv Minghui, Zhang jiayuan, Wang Aijie, Huang Ranran, Zhang Zengcai, Zhang Guowei
pmc-11605099.description: The topological attributes of structural covariance networks (SCNs) based on fractal dimension (FD) and changes in brain network connectivity were investigated using graph theory and network-based statistics (NBS) in patients with noise-induced hearing loss (NIHL). High-resolution 3D T1 images of 40 patients with NIHL and 38 healthy controls (HCs) were analyzed.

pmc-11608720.title: High-altitude retinopathy and retinal hemorrhage: A case report
pmc-11608720.creator: Rao Fu, Dachuan Liu, Yenan Wang
pmc-11608720.description: Rationale:High-altitude retinopathy (HAR) is a retinal disorder caused by prolonged exposure to hypoxic environments at high altitudes, posing a significant threat to visual health and potentially leading to severe vision impairment. There have been limited references of HAR, with observations of its clinical manifestations and prognosis remaining insufficient.

pmc-12446288.title: Altered actin isoforms expression and enhanced airway responsiveness in asthma: the crucial role of β-cytoplasmic actin
pmc-12446288.creator: Marisol Alvarez-González, Angélica Flores-Flores, Verónica Carbajal-Salinas, Blanca Bazán-Perkins
pmc-12446288.description: Airway hyperresponsiveness, caused by excessive contraction of airway smooth muscle, is a characteristic of asthma involving multiple proteins, including various isoforms of actin and myosin. While α-smooth muscle actin (ACTA2) is linked to hypercontractility, the roles of other isoforms are unclear.

pmc-12458892.title: Syndemics of depression, sick role and activation status among newly diagnosed adults with diabetes mellitus in Bahir Dar, Ethiopia: a 6-month follow-up study protocol
pmc-12458892.creator: Worku Awoke, Getu Degu Alene, Amha Admasie, Fentie Ambaw Getahun
pmc-12458892.description: AbstractIntroductionDiabetes mellitus (DM) and depression commonly coexist. Each condition increases the risk of developing the other and adversely affects treatment outcomes. Such complex interactions of diseases, referred to as syndemics, have not been well studied. This study aims to assess the syndemics of depression, sick role and activation status among newly diagnosed adults living with DM.

pmc-12564786.title: Public Health Impact of the MVA-BN Vaccine During the 2022 Mpox Outbreak: A Systematic Review
pmc-12564786.creator: Sarah C Katsandres, Suzanne K Scheele, Takako Kiener, Lisa Bloudek, Nicola Petrosillo
pmc-12564786.description: Background/Objectives: Previously endemic to sub-Saharan Africa, mpox has since emerged globally, resulting in more than 150,000 cases in over 100 countries in the 2022 outbreak. The Modified Vaccinia Ankara-Bavarian Nordic (MVA-BN) vaccine is licensed and recommended for at-risk populations in many countries and received World Health Organization (WHO) pre-qualification in September 2024.

pmc-12604666.title: GenTIGS: a database empowering research and clinical insights on rare genetic disorders with an Indian perspective
pmc-12604666.creator: Iliyas Rashid, Pooja S, Shivranjani C Moharir, Rakesh K Mishra
pmc-12604666.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Rare genetic disorders (RGDs) are conditions affecting fewer than 1 in 2000 individuals. Recent advances in genetics and healthcare renewed hope for better diagnosis and treatment. RGDs are common in India due to consanguinity and limited diagnostic testing. To converge the global- and India-specific knowledge about RGDs to a single platform for researchers, clinicians, and stakeholders, we developed GenTIGS database—a “go-to platform” for information retrieval and data analysis.

pmc-12963534.title: Martian ionospheric response during the May 2024 solar superstorm
pmc-12963534.creator: Jacob Parrott, Beatriz Sánchez-Cano, Håkan Svedhem, Olivier Witasse, Dikshita Meggi, Colin Wilson, Alejandro Cardesín-Moinelo, Ingo Müller-Wodarg
pmc-12963534.description: Solar energetic events can have considerable effects on planetary ionospheres. However, the erratic nature of these solar energetic events make observations difficult. Here we show a mutual radio occultation observation, which serendipitously occurred just 10 minutes after a large solar flare impacted Mars. This resulted in the largest lower ionospheric layer ever recorded, where it was 278% its typical size.

pmc-13548675.title: Breast DCE-MRI morphological features and semi-quantitative parameters associated with upgrade to invasive carcinoma in biopsyproven DCIS
pmc-13548675.creator: Vladimir Urban, Zorica Milosevic, Zoran Bukumiric, Katarina Obradovic, Nina Adzic, Dragana Pavlovic-Stankovic, Ivana Petkovic, Ivana Sovic, Irena Jovanic, Igor Spurnic
pmc-13548675.description: BackgroundThe aim of this study was to identify imaging predictors of upgrade to invasive carcinoma (IC) in patients with biopsy-proven ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) based on morphological features and semi-quantitative parameters derived from dynamic contrast-enhanced breast magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI).

pmc-13610305.title: Coupling Hydrological Scenarios and Water Footprints for Multi-Objective Cropping-Structure Optimization in the Middle and Lower Shiyang River Basin
pmc-13610305.creator: Yuhong Pu, Guangping Qi, Yubin Zhang, Yanxia Kang, Yayu Wang, Zhongxia Tang, Haohao Dang, Fusen Yang, Demin Fu
pmc-13610305.description: Hydrological fluctuations affect cropping-structure optimization in arid inland river basins by altering agricultural water-supply boundaries and crop yields. This study focused on five counties and districts in the middle and lower reaches of the Shiyang River Basin. Based on the 1995–2024 runoff series, four hydrological scenarios—wet, normal, dry, and extremely dry—were constructed.
